layout: 3 columns × 4 rows per atlas; four classes × three branches
prompts: Create one production game-art atlas for Shadowfall talent-tree backgrounds. EXACTLY 3 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, twelve equally sized separate PAINTED ENVIRONMENT SCENES, consistent grid with no gutters, no text, no lettering, no borders, no UI, no characters. Dark fantasy painterly RPG illustration, richly textured stone wood and metal, antique gold details, atmospheric depth. Each individual scene has a DARK uncluttered central 65% for talent nodes, the distinct narrative objects belong at lower corners and far edges. Separate scenes MUST have different locations and silhouettes, not recolors. Read row-major: ROW1 ROGUE three paths: Assassination, a crimson dagger shrine in rain-soaked assassin alley; Combat, bronze dueling courtyard with crossed sabers at bottom; Subtlety, blue-violet moonlit rooftops and veiled doorway. ROW2 WARLOCK: Affliction, violet occult altar with hanging curse talismans; Contagion, green poisoned marsh apothecary; Soulbinding, amber soulglass crypt full of trapped spectral flames. ROW3 SUMMONER: Legion, bone army gate and abandoned standards; Soulbond, teal spirit sanctuary with paired lanterns; Dominion, imperial obsidian necromancer throne. ROW4 RANGER: Marksman, autumn eagle lookout with bow and quiver on ledge; Survival, green forest camp with traps and animal tracks; Volley, silver-blue ruined watchtower with many arrows and storm clouds. Output a single tall atlas, prioritize exact uniform 3-by-4 layout and quiet centers.
